title: slopbuckets config
description: Configuration for buckets.config.json, read by the slopbuckets CLI.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor autocomplete.

adapter.description: Language adapter the CLI uses to read the project.

root.description: Folder of the root bucket, relative to the project.

alias.description: Import prefix for every internal import.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the bucket tree. The root bucket is level 0.
